rubric.role_summary: Senior operating partner supporting deep-tech portfolio companies with later-stage fundraising, lead-investor relationships, commercial positioning, and strategic transactions.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Senior operating partner supporting deep-tech portfolio companies with later-stage fundraising, lead-investor relationships, commercial positioning, and strategic transactions.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 10+ years of experience leading capital-raising efforts for technology companies.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience from an investment banking, corporate development, or venture capital background.
- 10+ years of relevant experience leading capital-raising efforts for technology companies from initial outreach through due diligence, valuation, and structuring.
- Track record of identifying and closing lead investors at later-stage technology companies.
- Network and ability to maintain connections with investors, acquirers, and advisors.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): San Francisco Bay Area, California. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Hybrid work is based in one of these areas.
